name: István Kovács
bio:
István's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the administrative offices. After graduating with a degree in Human Resources, he initially worked in the logistics industry, but his passion for racing led him to volunteer at local Hungarian rally events. This sparked a desire to combine his professional skills with his love for motorsport.

He quickly excelled, known for his meticulous approach to talent acquisition and development. István believes in fostering a supportive and challenging environment where individuals can reach their full potential. He's always looking for ways to improve team dynamics and communication, ensuring that everyone is aligned with the organization's goals. What sets him apart is his intuitive ability to identify hidden talent and nurture it, making him a valuable asset to any motorsport team.

István is driven by the belief that a team's success is directly tied to the well-being and motivation of its members. He is dedicated to creating a workplace where individuals feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best work, which ultimately translates to improved performance on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part.
physical.description: István is of average height with a slightly athletic build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk, even when traveling.
Has a habit of asking probing questions to understand the root cause of any issue.
